violations.message: Feature title 'Config: Strategy Defaults' contains invalid characters

result.note: PAIN POINT: The spec says 'colons in title text are part of the title' (domain_spec.md line 253), but colon (:) is not in [\w\s]+ charset. This creates a contradiction: if colons are part of the title text, then they would fail charset validation. Either colons ARE valid in titles (charset needs updating), or colons in title text are a parse error. The spec needs clarification. This simulation treats colon as charset-invalid based on the [\w\s]+ regex.
